meta_reflection.observation: Filings-first order is adequate only if period tags and intra-year coverage are true. For SBRY.L they are not: period_coverage annual=10/interim=0/trading_update=1 counts seven CH accounts (2020–2026), the 23 Apr prelim, the 2 Jun Annual Report and Notice of AGM, and a 24 Apr buyback-launch RNS as annual, while the transformative 31 Jul Argos sale sits as period=other and the Jan 2026 Q3 trading statement exists only as a news headline. yahoo_quarterly_cashflow is on the ladder but empty (TTM suppressed); alternate_news and ir_presentation_metrics are dead steps. Trading updates are first-class in the index summary but outside the annual/interim assignment rule, so the live 30 Jun grocery TU and the Argos RNS are easy to drop in favour of an AGM notice.

Four worker types plus a five-task cap force one annual body + a TU stand-in + news + screen + gap and leave no slot for the FY26 Companies House accounts (ch_00185647_MzUzNDA4NzU2M2FkaXF6a2N4, filed 21 Jul), the Annual Report PDF/RNS, the Argos sale body (915f30f0628b3048), or the buyback-programme launch. No task type exists to reconcile retail £574m / Yahoo £923m / screen £645m FCF, grocery versus Argos versus bank perimeter, or lease versus ex-lease net debt. Naive first-of-period selection would assign the AGM notice or the buyback launch as the annual. summarize_filing_body cannot carry period=annual|interim|trading_update|corporate_action, so the director must smuggle the June TU in as the missing interim.

The screen still emits buy (7/22, 4/5 families — quality failed — including High Dividend Yield and FCF Yield) while failed_models is [] despite 15/22 non-passes, TTM cashflow is suppressed, and fcf_definition_divergence / cash_conversion_overlay / interim_quality_overlay / leverage_override stay false on a three-way FCF split, FY25 FCF −£57m, and £5.54bn of leases. Research overlays already cut to Accumulate / medium / 0.68, and action_note repeats that paragraph many times, so the trial is asked to re-verify a headline Buy the overlay has already downgraded.

A 12-week persistent buy since 2026-08-02 with an in-flight buyback, a 31 Jul Argos disposal that has no assigned worker, a June TU that is the only 2026 intra-year operating print, no H1 statutory as of 4 Sep (typical Sainsbury November window), Qatar’s exit, and a live food-price-cap / grocery-share debate has no watch schema (Argos close/proceeds, H1 2026 results date, remaining buyback vs TVR, grocery volume vs price investment, FY27 guidance, bank residual). conviction_score 1.0 versus summary ‘Conviction 54%’ and stability_label=persistent are not substitutes for those monitors.

A generic FINANCIAL REVIEW / RISKS split will blend grocery, Argos general merchandise and residual financial services and will not force SEGMENT / PERIMETER (grocery vs Argos vs bank), FCF-DEFINITION (retail £574m vs Yahoo £923m vs screen £645m), LEASE vs EX-LEASE NET DEBT, CAPITAL RETURNS (4.1% dividend vs cash buybacks vs cancellations), or an explicit PRIMARY-FILING GAP box for the missing H1 statutory and the unassigned Argos RNS. Without those slots workers will treat TipRanks/Kalkine buyback reprints as colour and Yahoo 923m FCF as equivalent to screen 645m.
